title: The Subjunctive
completion_message: ¡Sublime! Has dominado el Subjuntivo en inglés. Esta estructura sutil, usada casi exclusivamente en inglés corporativo, diplomático y legal, marca la diferencia entre un hablante avanzado y un experto absoluto.

parts.visual:
En inglés moderno, el Subjuntivo es raro, pero se usa en contextos muy formales y corporativos para expresar demandas, sugerencias o necesidades. 

Regla de Oro: 
En el Subjuntivo, el verbo siempre va en su forma BASE (infinitivo sin 'to'), sin importar el sujeto (ni siquiera para He/She/It en presente). 

1. Con verbos de Demanda/Sugerencia (demand, insist, suggest, recommend, require): 
- Incorrecto: I demand that he RESIGNS. 
- Correcto: I demand that he RESIGN. 
- Incorrecto: They insisted that she PAYS the fine. 
- Correcto: They insisted that she PAY the fine.
parts.audio: Welcome to The Subjunctive Mood. In modern English, the subjunctive is rare, but it is heavily used in very formal, corporate, and legal contexts to express demands, suggestions, or necessity. The golden rule is this: In the subjunctive, the verb is always in its BASE form, without 'to'. This means no 's' for he, she, or it, and no past tense. Let's look at Number 1: With verbs of demand or suggestion like demand, insist, suggest, or recommend. Incorrect: I demand that he RESIGNS. Correct subjunctive: I demand that he RESIGN. Incorrect: They insisted that she PAYS the fine. Correct: They insisted that she PAY the fine.

parts.visual:
2. Con adjetivos de Necesidad/Importancia (It is crucial, vital, important, essential that...): 
- Incorrecto: It is vital that he IS informed immediately. 
- Correcto: It is vital that he BE informed immediately. 
- Incorrecto: It is essential that the CEO ATTENDS the meeting. 
- Correcto: It is essential that the CEO ATTEND the meeting. 

3. Subjuntivo Negativo (solo añade 'not' antes de la forma base): 
- Correcto: I recommend that you NOT SIGN the contract. 
- Correcto: It is crucial that he NOT KNOW about the merger.
parts.audio: Number 2: With adjectives of necessity or importance, such as It is crucial, vital, important, or essential. Incorrect: It is vital that he IS informed immediately. Correct subjunctive: It is vital that he BE informed immediately. Notice we use 'be', not 'is'. Incorrect: It is essential that the CEO ATTENDS the meeting. Correct: It is essential that the CEO ATTEND the meeting. Number 3: The negative subjunctive. Do not use 'don't' or 'doesn't'. Just add 'not' before the base verb. Correct: I recommend that you NOT SIGN the contract. Correct: It is crucial that he NOT KNOW about the merger.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma verbal correcta (modo subjuntivo) para contextos muy formales.

questions.question: The board of directors demands that the CEO ____ immediately.
questions.explanation: Demands that he RESIGN (forma base, sin 's').

questions.question: It is absolutely vital that she ____ informed of the lawsuit.
questions.explanation: It is vital that she BE informed (forma base de 'to be').

questions.question: I strongly suggest that he ____ a lawyer before talking to the press.
It is essential that the new policy ____ applied fairly to all employees.
questions.explanation: It is essential that it BE applied.

questions.question: Subjuntivo Negativo: My lawyer recommended that I ____ answer their questions.
The contract requires that the supplier ____ the materials by Friday.
Subjuntivo Negativo: It is crucial that the press ____ find out about the data breach.
questions.explanation: Crucial that they NOT FIND out.

questions.question: We insisted that the manager ____ us a full refund.
questions.explanation: Insisted that he GIVE (siempre forma base, incluso si la frase está en pasado 'insisted').

questions.question: It is imperative that everyone ____ on time for the negotiation.
The judge ordered that the prisoner ____ released immediately.
It was suggested that the meeting ____ postponed until next week.
questions.explanation: Suggested that it BE postponed (voz pasiva del subjuntivo).

questions.question: Subjuntivo Negativo: I insist that he ____ fired. He deserves a second chance.
questions.explanation: Negativo con verbo to be: NOT BE fired.

questions.question: The company policy mandates that every employee ____ two weeks of notice before resigning.
It is highly recommended that she ____ the job offer.
They requested that the deadline ____ extended.
My accountant advised that I ____ my taxes immediately to avoid a penalty.
¿Cuál de estas oraciones es INCORRECTA (no usa subjuntivo formal)?
options: I suggest that he talks to the manager.
I suggest that he talk to the manager.
I suggest that he not talk to the manager.
It is vital that he talk to the manager.
questions.correct_answer: I suggest that he talks to the manager.
questions.explanation: Incorrecta en inglés muy formal. Debería ser 'he talk' sin la 's'.

questions.question: Subjuntivo en pasado (Irreal): I wouldn't do that if I ____ you.
Subjuntivo en pasado: I wish it ____ Friday today.
Subjuntivo Negativo: It is critical that the server ____ go offline during the broadcast.
questions.explanation: Critical that the server NOT go offline.
